en.title: Anthropic Hits Nasdaq with Record IPO as Tech Giants Report Massive AI Revenue and Spending Shifts
en.summary: Anthropic has officially gone public on Nasdaq, raising over $100 billion in what marks the **largest IPO in history**. Meanwhile, industry heavyweights like Nvidia, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Baidu have released major model updates and financial reports, while emerging signs of **cautious infrastructure investment** ripple through the global market.
en.full_summary: This week's tech roundup covers landmark capital market events and rapid technological iterations. Anthropic made history by ringing the Nasdaq opening bell, pulling in a total of over $107 billion through its IPO and private placements. In financial highlights, Nvidia reported its **first-ever single-quarter revenue exceeding $100 billion**, driven by booming data center demand, though its temporary CEO noted that future supply chain investments will become more rigorous. Similarly, major Chinese tech firms released strong results: Baidu's AI cloud infrastructure revenue grew by 94% year-over-year, and Alibaba's AI-related product revenue surpassed 17.9 billion yuan. On the model front, OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Microsoft rolled out seven new proprietary AI models, and Tencent released Hy4 flash. However, shifting macroeconomic policies and supply chain constraints are taking shape, as the US introduced restrictions on remote access to advanced AI computing power, and research institutions like SemiAnalysis and JPMorgan projected potential slowdowns or diversification in future AI capital expenditures.

zh.title: Anthropic创史上最大规模IPO纪录，各大科技巨头密集发布财报与战略调整
zh.summary: Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克，募资超千亿美元，创下**史上最大规模IPO纪录**。与此同时，英伟达、微软、OpenAI及百度等行业巨头密集发布了最新财报与模型产品，而全球AI基础设施投资也开始出现趋于**审慎和调整**的新信号。
zh.full_summary: 本周科技行业迎来了一系列重磅资本事件与技术迭代。Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克，通过IPO及私募配售总共募集超过1070亿美元，创下**史上最大规模IPO纪录**。在财报方面，英伟达单季营收**首次突破1000亿美元大关**，不过其临时CEO表示未来对AI供应链的投资将更加审慎和严谨。国内大厂同样交出亮眼成绩单，百度AI云基础设施收入同比增长94%，阿里AI相关产品收入突破179亿元，DeepSeek第二轮融资也顺利落地，募资金额庞大。技术与产品上，OpenAI发布GPT-6.2系列模型，微软推出七款自研AI模型，腾讯混元则发布了降本增效的Hy4 flash。但在宏观政策与行业趋势层面，美国商务部发布了限制远程获取先进AI算力的临时规则，且多家研究机构指出未来AI算力资本开支可能面临调整与多元化竞争。

en.title: Apple Developing AI Agents to Control Devices, While Anthropic Tops Trillion-Dollar Valuation After IPO
en.summary: Apple is recruiting engineers to build **AI agents** capable of writing code, browsing the web, and controlling applications. Meanwhile, Claude developer Anthropic went public on Nasdaq, with its market value briefly surging past **$2 trillion** on its first trading day before closing at around $1.27 trillion.
en.full_summary:
Apple has added a job posting for a senior engineering manager to develop proactive AI assistants capable of executing multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, and codebases, with a target timeline around late next year. Concurrently, Apple is tightening third-party AI permissions in macOS, increasing verification steps for tools like ChatGPT.

In the AI industry, Anthropic completed its historic IPO on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Priced at $83 per share, the stock surged on debut, pushing its valuation briefly past $2 trillion before closing up 17% at $97.17, yielding a market cap of roughly $1.27 billion.

Other notable developments include Google bringing Computer Use to Mac versions of Gemini, allowing background app control, and DeepSeek completing an equity restructuring that brought in major industry backers like Tencent and Contemporary Amperex Technology.

zh.title: 苹果正开发AI智能体接管电脑，Anthropic上市市值突破万亿美元
zh.summary: 苹果正在招募人才开发能够代用户编写代码、上网和**控制应用**的AI智能体。与此同时，Claude开发商Anthropic在纳斯达克挂牌上市，首日盘中市值曾短暂突破**2万亿美元**，最终收盘市值约为1.27万亿美元。
zh.full_summary:
苹果近期在官网发布招聘信息，着手开发能够跨应用、浏览器和代码库执行多步骤任务的**主动式AI智能体**，计划最早在明年底推出相关服务。与此同时，苹果在macOS测试版中收紧了第三方AI工具的控制权限，增加了用户的授权步骤。

在AI资本市场方面，Claude的开发商Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克。其IPO发行价为每股83美元，首日盘中股价大涨，**市值一度突破2万亿美元**，最终收盘上涨17.07%，收盘市值约为1.27万亿美元，成为近期全球瞩目的科技大事件。

此外，科技行业多点开花：Google为Mac版Gemini推出了可在后台操作应用的Computer Use功能；深度求索DeepSeek则完成了工商变更，引入了腾讯、宁德时代等一众产业资本与投资机构作为重要股东。

en.title: Anthropic shares close 17% higher on first day of trading
en.summary: AI giant Anthropic became the first major model developer to list on Wall Street, raising a record $81.3 billion in its **Nasdaq debut**. Despite market jitters and tech bubble fears, the company's shares closed 17% higher, giving ordinary investors their **first direct stake** in a leading standalone AI developer.
en.full_summary:
On Thursday, November 19, 2026, AI maker Anthropic made history as the first leading model developer to go public on Wall Street, defying a broad market sell-off and tech bubble concerns. The company priced its shares at $83, but they opened at $111.50 and ultimately closed around $97, up 17% for the day. 

## Record Fundraising and Valuation
Anthropic raised an unprecedented **$81.3 billion** by selling 980 million shares, comfortably surpassing previous megadebuts like SpaceX. The IPO valued the five-year-old creator of the Claude chatbot at roughly **$1.5 trillion** initially, with its opening valuation surging to around $2 trillion. Chief Executive Dario Amodei stated that the robust financial position reinforces the company's commitment to building safe AI.

## Explosive Growth and Market Jitters
The historic listing comes amid rapid financial growth, with Anthropic reporting third-quarter revenue surging to **$17 billion**, up dramatically from $1.4 billion a year prior, largely driven by coding applications. However, the debut also drew scrutiny: critics and protesters voiced concerns over potential **existential risks** and financial market stability, while the broader tech sector navigated ongoing turbulence surrounding chip giant Nvidia.

zh.title: Anthropic 登陆华尔街，首日收盘大涨 17%
zh.summary: 人工智能巨头 Anthropic 成为首家登陆华尔街的主流大模型开发商，在纳斯达克成功 **首次公开募股** 并创下纪录。尽管市场对科技泡沫有所担忧，其股价在首日依然大涨，为普通投资者提供了**直接投资**顶尖 AI 企业的机会。
zh.full_summary:
2026 年 11 月 19 日周四，人工智能巨头 Anthropic 正式登陆纳斯达克，成为首家在华尔街上市的主流大模型开发商。尽管市场面临科技股抛售压力和泡沫担忧，该公司依然逆势上扬，发行价定为 83 美元，开盘报 111.50 美元，最终以约 97 美元收盘，首日涨幅达 17%。

## 创纪录的融资与估值
Anthropic 通过此次 IPO 发行了 9.8 亿股，总计筹集了创纪录的 **813 亿美元**资金，规模超越了此前的知名企业上市。这家由前 OpenAI 员工于 5 年前创立的公司，其初始估值达到约 1.5 万亿美元，开盘时估值更是飙升至 **2 万亿美元**左右。首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代伊表示，这让公司拥有更强的财务实力去推进安全 AI 的研发。

## 惊人的业务增长与市场争议
此次上市伴随着极其强劲的业绩支撑，Anthropic 第三季度营收飙升至 **170 亿美元**，远高于去年同期的 14 亿美元，这主要得益于客户对其编程 AI 模型的强劲需求。不过，这场历史性的 IPO 也伴随着争议，部分抗议者和议员对人工智能可能带来的**系统性风险**以及泡沫破裂对普通投资者退休金的潜在威胁表达了担忧。

en.title: Anthropic makes history with $81bn IPO as shares close up 17%
en.summary: Anthropic pulled off the largest IPO in history, raising **$81bn** and briefly hitting a **$2tn** valuation on its first day of trading. Despite the massive debut and a closing price up about 17% at $97, it wasn't enough to rescue the broader stock market, which closed sharply lower amid ongoing investor worries about the AI boom.
en.full_summary:
## Trading Debut and Market Valuation
Anthropic officially went public on the Nasdaq, pricing its shares at $83 before opening at $111.50. During its first trading session, the creator of the Claude chatbot briefly crossed a **$2tn valuation**, though it settled at a closing price of roughly $97, leaving its market cap around **$1.3tn to $1.75tn**. The blockbuster offering raised $81bn, surpassing SpaceX's previous record.

## Wider Market Slump
Despite the massive enthusiasm for Anthropic, Wall Street closed sharply lower, with the S&P 500 falling for its sixth straight session. Broader investor anxiety about the sustainability of the AI boom, combined with recent tech sector turbulence involving Nvidia, dragged down major indices. Meanwhile, IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva warned that surging global demand for AI infrastructure is driving up inflation and could force central banks to raise interest rates.

## Founder Fortunes and Safety Warnings
The IPO generated massive paper wealth for Anthropic's seven co-founders, whose stakes are now valued at over **$180bn**, with plans to donate significant portions to philanthropic causes. Shortly before ringing the opening bell, CEO Dario Amodei issued a public warning acknowledging the real risks of AI, from economic disruption to loss of control, emphasizing that avoiding these dangers depends entirely on prioritizing safety.

zh.title: Anthropic 创下史上最大规模 IPO，首日收盘大涨 17%
zh.summary: AI 独角兽 Anthropic 迎来了史上最大规模的首次公开募股，筹集了 **810亿美元**，并在首个交易日盘中市值一度冲高至 **2万亿美元**。尽管其股价最终收在约 97 美元、比发行价上涨了约 17%，但依然没能拯救整体表现低迷的股市，华尔街各大指数集体下跌。
zh.full_summary:
## 资本市场首秀
人工智能公司 Anthropic 在纳斯达克成功上市，完成了有史以来规模最大的 IPO。其发行价定为每股 83 美元，开盘价冲高至 111.50 美元，盘中市值一度突破 **2万亿美元**。虽然随后有所回落，但首日收盘价仍定格在 97 美元左右，涨幅约 17%，公司整体估值维持在万亿美元高位，共筹集了 **810亿美元** 的资金。

## 市场反应与宏观影响
尽管 Anthropic 的上市备受瞩目，但未能提振整体低迷的华尔街股市。受对 AI 泡沫的担忧以及此前英伟达相关风波的影响，美国三大股指集体收跌。国际货币基金组织（IMF）负责人克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃随后警告称，全球对 AI 硬件的狂热需求正在推高通货膨胀，未来可能迫使各大央行上调利率。

## 创始人财富与安全警告
这场创纪录的上市让 Anthropic 的七位联合创始人身价暴涨，其纸面财富总额超过 **1800亿美元**，并计划将大部分股份捐赠给慈善事业。在敲响开市钟前，公司 CEO 达里奥·阿莫代伊公开提醒外界注意 AI 技术带来的经济动荡与失控等真实风险，并强调是否将安全放在首位将决定未来的走向。

en.title: Google Quantum AI proves quantum contextuality works at scale on Willow processor
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google Quantum AI researchers report demonstrating **quantum contextuality** on their Willow superconducting quantum processors, outperforming classical strategies across tasks involving up to 105 qubits. Published in Science, the work provides an experimental test showing that quantum systems do not assign **fixed, pre-existing values** to unmeasured properties, serving as both a core computational resource and a strict hardware benchmark.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

## Beating the classical limit
Researchers ran the magic square game on the Willow quantum processor, using entangled Bell pairs instead of a pre-written table. While the best classical strategy wins at most 88.89% of the time, the qubits won **98.30% of the time**, proving that answers take shape only upon measurement according to their context.

## Measuring contextuality at scale
Using a Bell-Kochen-Specker inequality, the team measured a contextuality score of **5.590**, comfortably past the classical bound of 4 and close to the quantum limit of 6. They also scaled the experiment using the GHZ parity game and solved hidden linear function problems on grids of up to 105 qubits.

## A new hardware ruler
These tasks demand strict agreement among multiple qubits, exposing subtle coherent errors that conventional random-circuit benchmarks miss. This provides an **objective performance ceiling** grounded in physics rather than shifting classical standards.

zh.title: 谷歌量子AI团队证明量子语境性可在柳树处理器的大规模系统中运行
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：谷歌量子AI研究人员报告称，他们在柳树超导量子处理器上成功演示了**量子语境性**，在涉及多达105个量子比特的任务中超越了经典策略。这项发表在《科学》杂志上的研究提供了一项实验测试，表明量子系统不会为未测量的属性赋予**固定且预先存在的数值**，这既可以作为核心计算资源，也可以作为严格的硬件基准。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

## 打破经典极限
研究人员在柳树量子处理器上运行了幻方游戏，使用纠缠的贝尔对替代了预先写好的表格。尽管最佳经典策略的胜率最多为88.89%，但这些量子比特的胜率达到了**98.30%**，证明了答案只有在根据其语境进行测量时才会成形。

## 大规模测量语境性
研究团队利用贝尔-科琴-斯佩克尔不等式，测得了5.590的语境性评分，舒适地超越了4的经典界限，并接近6的量子极限。他们还使用GHZ宇称游戏扩展了实验，并在多达105个量子比特的网格上解决了隐藏线性函数问题。
## 全新的硬件标尺
这些任务要求多个量子比特之间保持严格的一致性，从而暴露出常规随机电路基准测试容易遗漏的微妙相干误差。这提供了一个植根于物理学而非不断变化的经典标准的**客观性能上限**。

en.title: Anthropic Hits $2 Trillion Valuation in Nasdaq Debut After Shares Surge 34%
en.summary: Anthropic became the world's first publicly traded frontier AI company by hitting a **$2 trillion market value** during its Nasdaq debut. The stock opened 34% higher than its IPO price, driven by massive **investor demand**. This successful listing, alongside Nvidia's recent earnings, acts as a major market test for the **future of AI** investments.
en.full_summary:
## IPO Performance and Valuation
According to Reuters, Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share after selling 980 million shares, raising substantial capital ahead of its public debut. When trading began, the stock opened at $111.5, representing a **34% surge** over the IPO price and pushing the company's total market capitalization past the $2 trillion threshold. This milestone makes Anthropic the world's first publicly traded frontier AI company, positioning it alongside tech giants like Microsoft, Apple, and Nvidia in the trillion-dollar club.

## Industry Implications and Market Sentiment
Market analysts view this blockbuster debut, alongside Nvidia's recent earnings report, as a crucial test of investor confidence in the AI sector amid ongoing debates over heavy spending and profitability. While early backers and founders, including CEO Dario Amodei, reaped massive financial gains, some market skeptics warn that Anthropic still faces heavy pressure to turn a profit and manage nearly **$900 billion** in future computing commitments with partners like Amazon and Google.

zh.title: AI巨头Anthropic登陆纳斯达克：首日大涨34%，市值突破2万亿美元
zh.summary: AI初创公司Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克，首日股价大涨34%，市值一举冲上**2万亿美元**大关。作为全球首家上市的前沿AI企业，此次IPO吸引了大量资金疯狂涌入，成为检验市场对人工智能热情的重要**行业风向标**。
zh.full_summary:
## 资本市场的高光时刻
据路透社报道，Anthropic将首次公开募股的发行价定为每股83美元，共计发售9.8亿股。上市首日，该股开盘价达到111.5美元，较发行价大幅飙升34%，市值一举突破**2万亿美元**。作为全球首家公开上市的前沿人工智能企业，Anthropic成功跻身由微软、苹果和英伟达等巨头把持的“万亿俱乐部”，创造了科技资本市场的又一历史记录。

## 行业影响与潜在挑战
此次巨额IPO与英伟达近期的财报一起，被视为缓解市场对AI泡沫和巨额资本开支焦虑的重要测试。尽管包括CEO达里奥·阿莫代伊在内的创始团队迎来了巨额财富爆发，但部分分析师指出，Anthropic仍需直面盈利压力，并背负着与亚马逊、谷歌等伙伴高达近**900亿美元**的算力承诺，未来发展依然任重道远。

en.title: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0: New Model Additions and Major Cache Renaming
en.summary: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 brings **exciting new models** including Inkling 2 Mini, Apertus 1.5, and Omnilingual ASR, alongside a **critical breaking change** that standardizes cache parameter names to improve library consistency.
en.full_summary:
## Overview of v5.24.0

The Hugging Face Transformers library has released version 5.24.0, introducing a wide array of new model integrations, performance enhancements, and crucial breaking changes designed to streamline the ecosystem.

## New Model Additions

This release adds support for several advanced models across text, vision, and audio domains. Key additions include **Inkling 2 Mini** by Thinking Machines Lab, a multimodal model featuring a looping mechanism, and **Apertus 1.5**, a multimodal model supporting text, images, and audio. Other notable integrations include NVIDIA's looped language model **Dory**, Meta FAIR's **Omnilingual ASR** covering over 1,600 languages, and various architectures like SarvamMLA and EXAONE.

## Breaking Changes and Cache Standardization

A **major architectural update** in this release is the renaming of `past_key_values` and `cache_params` to a **single unified name: `cache`** across the entire library. While fully backward compatible with deprecation warnings until future versions, this change eliminates historical naming inconsistencies between attention and linear-attention models.

zh.title: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 版本发布：加入多款新模型与重大缓存重命名
zh.summary: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 版本带来了 Inkling 2 Mini、Apertus 1.5 和 Omnilingual ASR 等**备受瞩目的新模型**，并引入了一项**关键的不兼容更新**，将缓存参数统一命名以提升库的一致性。
zh.full_summary:
## v5.24.0 版本概述

Hugging Face Transformers 库正式发布了 v5.24.0 版本，引入了大量全新的模型集成、性能优化以及旨在简化生态系统的关键破坏性变更。

## 全新模型加入

本次更新为文本、视觉和音频领域引入了多款先进模型。其中包含来自 Thinking Machines Lab 的多模态模型 **Inkling 2 Mini**（采用循环机制）、支持图文音的多模态模型 **Apertus 1.5**。其他重要集成还包括英伟达的循环语言模型 **Dory**、Meta FAIR 覆盖超 1600 种语言的 **Omnilingual ASR**，以及 SarvamMLA 和 EXAONE 等多种架构。

## 破坏性变更与缓存标准化

本次发布的一项**核心架构更新**是将 `past_key_values` 和 `cache_params` 在整个库中统一重命名为**单一名称：`cache`**。尽管在后续版本之前完全向下兼容并带有废弃警告，但此举消除了注意力机制模型与线性注意力模型之间历史命名不一致的问题。

en.title: Researcher plants 2 million canaries in AI supply chain and exposes major privacy leaks
en.summary: Security researcher HD Moore planted two million trackable secrets into AI prompts to trace how sensitive information travels through modern AI services. According to Ars Technica, the experiment revealed that AI brokers, inference resellers, and cloud providers frequently leak data, **ignore privacy settings**, and sometimes fall victim to hackers who steal sensitive prompts at the front door.
en.full_summary: As reported by Ars Technica, security researcher HD Moore conducted an experiment by sending nearly two million AI prompts containing unique, trackable secrets—such as AWS access keys and private git references—through various AI routers and inference services. The findings show that the complex AI supply chain leaks sensitive data heavily. Specifically, at least three AI hosting providers were compromised by attackers who stole AWS keys right at the provider's front door, even when requests were rejected before running a model. Furthermore, some inference resellers logged and passed along prompts to unauthorized parties, while certain AI labs scraped secret URLs embedded in prompts despite explicit 'zero data retention' policies. Moore suggests that using on-premises servers or dealing directly with first-tier providers can minimize risks, though complete privacy remains extremely difficult to guarantee in the current AI ecosystem.

zh.title: 安全研究员在AI供应链中投放200万个诱饵，暴露出惊人的隐私泄露问题
zh.summary: 安全研究员HD Moore在AI提示词中投放了200万个可追踪的机密诱饵，用来测试敏感信息在各种AI服务中的流向。据Ars Technica报道，这场实验发现AI中间商、分销商和云服务商经常发生数据泄漏，不仅**无视隐私设置**，甚至还会遭遇黑客直接在前端窃取用户的敏感提示词。
zh.full_summary: 据Ars Technica报道，安全研究员HD Moore通过一项大规模实验，向各种AI路由和推理服务发送了近200万个包含独家可追踪机密（如AWS访问密钥和私有git链接）的AI提示词。结果显示，复杂的AI供应链存在严重的数据泄漏问题。具体而言，至少有三家AI托管服务商遭到黑客入侵，攻击者在服务商的前端直接窃取了AWS密钥，甚至连那些在模型运行前就被拒绝的请求也未能幸免。此外，一些推理分销商会记录并向外界传递提示词，而某些AI实验室则在违反“零数据保留”政策的情况下，抓取提示词中包含的私密网址。研究员建议，使用本地服务器或直接与一线大厂合作可以降低风险，但在目前的AI生态中，想要完全保证隐私安全依然极其困难。

en.title: Harness adapters: tailoring AI models for specific agent frameworks to boost performance and cut costs
en.summary: Researchers show that training AI models using reinforcement learning **inside specific agent harnesses** makes them significantly more accurate and efficient. Instead of relying on general-purpose performance, adding a custom **LoRA adapter** helps models solve complex coding tasks with far fewer tool calls and lower token consumption.
en.full_summary:
Large language models are typically trained for general performance, meaning they leave room for improvement when paired with specific agent harnesses for targeted tasks. To bridge this gap, researchers trained custom LoRA adapters using reinforcement learning (RL) directly within three popular agent harnesses: Pi, Hermes Agent, and OpenCode. Using a filtered dataset of validation-screened programming tasks, the team leveraged TRL's AsyncGRPOTrainer alongside Hugging Face infrastructure to optimize the Qwen 3.8-27B model. 

Evaluation results indicate that specialist adapters consistently outperform the base model under their respective harnesses across benchmarks like Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Pro, achieving **significant accuracy gains** while reducing tool calls by over 50%. Furthermore, researchers successfully merged the three separate adapters into a single **super-adapter**, which retains strong multi-framework compatibility and efficiency without requiring complex retraining.

zh.title: 给AI模型配上专用“适配器”，干活更准还更省钱
zh.summary: 研究表明，用强化学习在**特定智能体框架**里训练AI模型，能大幅提升干活的准确率和效率。比起依赖通用大模型，加上专门的**微调适配器**后，模型解决复杂的编程任务时不仅出错更少，还能大幅减少调用工具的次数和消耗。
zh.full_summary:
大语言模型通常追求通用性能，在配合具体的智能体框架执行特定任务时，往往无法发挥出全部潜力。为了解决这个问题，研究人员直接在三个主流的智能体框架（Pi、Hermes Agent 和 OpenCode）内部，通过强化学习为模型训练了专属的微调适配器。研发团队利用经过严格筛选的编程任务数据集，结合相关训练工具对 Qwen 3.8-27B 模型进行了深度优化。

评估结果显示，这些专属适配器在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SWE-bench Pro 等基准测试中，**全面超越了基础模型**，不仅准确率显著提升，工具调用次数也减少了一半以上。此外，研究人员还将三个独立的适配器融合成了一个**超级适配器**，在不重新训练的情况下，就能在多个框架中同时保持高效的性能表现。

en.title: Anthropic Closes Massive Initial Public Offering and Private Placement

en.title: Inkling 2 Mini: A compact multimodal AI model with loop architecture for local setups
en.summary: Thinking Machines Lab has released Inkling 2 Mini, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model designed for **local AI setups**. With around 26 billion total physical parameters and 3 billion active parameters per token, it uses a clever **looping mechanism** to simulate a much larger model. It supports a 1-million-token context window and handles both text and images, delivering top-tier performance for its size.
en.full_summary:
Thinking Machines Lab reports that Inkling 2 Mini features 24 decoder layers, with the 12 middle layers running three times in a loop to act as 48 logical layers. This design allows the model to maintain a compact physical size while retaining high capacity. It uses NVFP4 and MXFP8 expert weights and supports a 1-million-token context size.

In benchmark tests, the model leads in 32 out of 48 categories against similar mid-sized models, excelling in coding, agentic search, and vision interpretation. Inference support is available out-of-the-box through transformers, llama.cpp, MLX, and SGLang, alongside a DSpark drafter for speculative decoding speed-ups.

zh.title: Inkling 2 Mini：采用循环架构的紧凑型多模态本地 AI 模型
zh.summary: Thinking Machines Lab 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一款专为**本地 AI 部署**设计的混合专家多模态模型。它拥有约 260 亿总物理参数和每个 token 30 亿激活参数，通过巧妙的**循环机制**模拟出了更大的模型效果。该模型支持 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，并能处理文本和图像，在同尺寸中性能表现优异。
zh.full_summary:
据 Thinking Machines Lab 称，Inkling 2 Mini 包含 24 个解码器层，其中中间 12 层会循环运行 3 次，从而起到 48 个逻辑层的作用。这种设计使模型在保持紧凑物理体积的同时，拥有了更高的容量。它采用 NVFP4 和 MXFP8 专家权重，并支持 100 万 token 的上下文长度。

在基准测试中，该模型在与同级别中型模型的对比中，在 48 个类别里有 32 个处于领先地位，在编程、智能搜索和视觉理解方面表现突出。官方通过 transformers、llama.cpp、MLX 和 SGLang 提供了即开即用的推理支持，并附带用于加速的 DSpark 推测解码器。

en.title: Sakana AI launches independent Security Research Group for AI cyber defense
en.summary: According to Sakana AI: Sakana AI is launching an independent research team called the **Security Research Group** to study AI-driven cyber defense and AI safety. Led by Akihiro Umegai and David Ha, the group aims to shift the focus of cybersecurity from downstream patching to upstream **design-stage prevention**, helping address rising vulnerabilities and structural challenges in Japan and globally.
en.full_summary:
According to Sakana AI:

Sakana AI is establishing an independent R&D organization, the Security Research Group, dedicated to collective, AI-driven cyber defense and the safety of AI systems. According to the company, frontier AI has drastically accelerated the discovery of software flaws, with NIST reporting a 263% surge in CVE submissions between 2020 and 2025. Concurrently, attackers are weaponizing AI agents to launch simultaneous intrusions, putting immense pressure on traditional patching workflows.

To counter this, Sakana AI argues that faster response and routine patching are no longer enough. The group advocates for a **secure-by-design** approach, treating security as an essential Kano-model "must-be quality" built into software from its inception. Facing structural constraints in Japan such as outsourced operations, technical debt, and limited IT staff, the research group will focus on upstream prevention, AI-based collective defense, and securing AI agents against misuse.

Led by Akihiro Umegai and David Ha, the group plans to operate with vendor neutrality and maintain responsible disclosure principles, bridging the gap between national security policies and practical industry implementation.

zh.title: Sakana AI 宣布成立独立的“安全研究组”，专注于 AI 网络防御
zh.summary: 据Sakana AI发布的信息：Sakana AI 宣布成立名为 **Security Research Group** 的独立研发团队，专门研究 AI 驱动的网络防御与 AI 自身安全。该团队由梅谷晃宏和 David Ha 共同领导，旨在将网络防御的重心从下游的打补丁转向上游的 **设计阶段预防**，以应对日本乃至全球日益严峻的漏洞激增与结构性挑战。
zh.full_summary:
据Sakana AI发布的信息：

Sakana AI 宣布成立名为 Security Research Group 的独立研发团队，专注于研究基于 AI 的集体网络防御以及 AI 系统自身的安全性。该公司指出，随着前沿 AI 快速普及，软件漏洞的披露数量呈爆发式增长，美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）的数据显示 2020 年至 2025 年间 CVE 提交量激增了 263%。与此同时，攻击者也在利用 AI 代理同时对多个目标发动攻击，给传统的打补丁模式带来了巨大压力。

面对这一趋势，Sakana AI 认为单纯依靠更快的漏洞响应和事后修补已无法根治风险。该团队主张从根本入手，将安全视为狩野模型中的“**当たり前品質（理所应当的品质）**”，在软件设计和开发的上流阶段就彻底消灭漏洞。针对日本市场普遍存在的IT外包、技术债和人手短缺等结构性难题，该研究组将重点探索预防性设计、AI 集体协同防御以及保护防御型 AI 自身安全。

该研究组由梅谷晃宏和 David Ha 共同领导，并将秉持 **供应商中立** 的原则，以负责任的方式公开白皮书和防御剧本，致力于打通政策框架与企业日常安全实务之间的技术桥梁。

en.title: Jeff Bezos Returns as CEO to Build Prometheus, an AI Startup for the Physical World
en.summary: Former Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos has returned to a chief executive role at AI startup Prometheus, which has raised about $14.5 billion and reached a **$410 billion valuation**. The company aims to build **general engineering agents** to revolutionize physical manufacturing and hardware design, bypassing traditional text-based AI limits.
en.full_summary:
At the Semafor Silicon Valley and the World summit, Jeff Bezos revealed his new role as co-founder and co-CEO of Prometheus alongside physicist Vik Bajaj. The company, which employs about 250 people, focuses on numerical simulation neural agents and multi-physics models to transform computer-aided design and physical simulation. Bezos stated that tasks requiring 10 to 20 engineers six to nine months can now be completed by the system in **under 12 hours**, with Blue Origin already running internal tests on two projects.

Unlike text-based models, Prometheus tackles the complex challenge of industrial data scarcity by using self-developed **multi-physics simulation systems** to generate synthetic data. Despite massive funding from top-tier financial institutions, experts note that physical world applications carry zero tolerance for error, and achieving generalization across diverse engineering fields remains a **massive technical challenge**.

zh.title: 估值 410 亿美元，贝佐斯打造「物理世界的 OpenAI」
zh.summary: 前亚马逊 CEO 杰夫·贝佐斯重返一线，担任 AI 初创公司 Prometheus 的联席 CEO。该公司已累计筹集约 145 亿美元资金，**估值达到 410 亿美元**。其终极目标是打造**通用 AI 工程师**，用原子的 AI 重构实体制造业与工程设计。
zh.full_summary:
在 Semafor 峰会上，贝佐斯首次以 Prometheus 联合创始人兼联席 CEO 的身份公开亮相。这家仅有约 250 名员工的公司目前已累计筹集约 145 亿美元，估值飙升至 410 亿美元。据贝佐斯透露，以往需要数十名工程师耗时数月完成的硬件设计，该系统在 **12 小时内即可完成**，其名下的蓝色起源已在内部展开私密测试。

针对工业领域普遍缺乏公开数据的痛点，Prometheus 避开纯文本路线，依靠自研的**多物理场仿真系统**生成合成数据来训练基础模型。不过，物理世界的验证容错率为零，要在机械、热力等异构学科间实现**通用泛化**，仍面临极大的技术挑战。

en.title: Robotics enters its post-Jensen Huang era
en.summary: NVIDIA's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation, leaving the robotics industry without one of its most prominent advocates and financial backers. While Huang helped elevate robotics through keynote spotlights, development infrastructure, and strategic investments, his departure and potential shifts in NVIDIA's priorities test the young industry's momentum.
en.full_summary:
Jensen Huang's departure following his resignation from NVIDIA marks a turning point for the robotics industry, where he served as a central champion for physical AI. Over the years, Huang used his keynote platforms to showcase humanoid robots, fund struggling startups like Serve Robotics, and build a comprehensive development stack spanning GPUs, simulation tools like Omniverse, and foundation models like GR00T.

Industry leaders acknowledge that Huang's steady attention and willingness to invest in early-stage markets made it significantly easier for robotics founders to secure funding and credibility. However, with interim CEO Colette Kress at the helm and potential pressures from data center competition and regulatory scrutiny, the future of NVIDIA's direct support, keynote spotlights, and strategic investments in robotics remains uncertain.

Despite these concerns, many experts believe the robotics flywheel is already spinning on its own, supported by alternative hardware competitors and widespread developer momentum. Yet, as humanoid developers face mounting pressure to prove actual commercial use cases and secure future funding over the next year, the loss of Huang's unique charisma and institutional backing leaves a notable void in the ecosystem.

zh.title: 机器人行业正式迎来“后黄仁勋时代”
zh.summary: 英伟达董事会接受了黄仁勋的辞职，这让机器人行业失去了一位最具影响力的**代言人和关键金主**。虽然黄仁勋此前通过主题演讲、开发工具和战略投资大力推动了机器人技术的发展，但他离开后英伟达未来战略的不确定性，将对这个正处于快速成长期的新兴行业带来**全新考验**。
zh.full_summary:
黄仁勋卸任英伟达CEO标志着机器人行业迎来了一个转折点。过去多年里，黄仁勋不仅在各大主题演讲中频繁为机器人摇旗呐喊，还通过真金白银的战略投资和技术支持，扶持了包括 Serve Robotics 在内的多家初创企业，构建了从芯片、仿真软件到基础模型的完整开发生态。

多位机器人行业高管表示，黄仁勋的持续关注极大地提升了整个行业的知名度与投资信心。然而，随着英伟达进入过渡期，加上核心数据中心业务面临的竞争与监管压力，英伟达未来是否会延续对机器人板块的大力投入和早期支持成为了未知数。

尽管业内人士普遍认为机器人行业的底层技术和生态已经具备一定的发展惯性，但随着人形机器人企业在未来一年内面临落实商业化落地的真实大考，失去这样一位重量级盟友和强音代言人，对整个行业而言无疑是一次重大的**生态缺失**。

en.title: OpenAI details how it blocks bad actors from stealing AI reasoning capabilities
en.summary: According to OpenAI News: OpenAI explains how it detects and stops **adversarial distillation**, a technique bad actors use to copy advanced AI capabilities without safety protections. The company highlights new defenses in **GPT-6.2 Astra** that dramatically lower the success rate of stealing the AI's internal reasoning steps.
en.full_summary: According to OpenAI News: OpenAI reports that unauthorized distillation allows bad actors to reproduce frontier AI capabilities, such as advanced coding or cyber skills, without safety safeguards. Attackers often target a model's protected reasoning, which is the internal chain of thought generated while working toward an answer. To counter this, OpenAI combines adversarial training, input and output classifiers, and strict API-level protections. In tests with GPT-6.2 Astra, the average attack success rate for extracting reasoning from an earlier request dropped from 54.0% to 0.2%. OpenAI also conducts campaign-level investigations to disrupt coordinated extraction attempts and supports U.S. legislation and export controls to address national security risks.

zh.title: OpenAI 详解如何阻止恶意分子“偷师”AI 的思考过程
zh.summary: 据OpenAI News发布的信息：OpenAI 详细介绍了如何检测和打击**对抗性蒸馏**，这是一种坏人用来复制高级人工智能能力却不带安全保护的手法。该公司重点介绍了 **GPT-6.2 Astra** 中的全新防御机制，大幅降低了窃取 AI 内部思考步骤的成功率。
zh.full_summary: 据OpenAI News发布的信息：OpenAI 报告称，未经授权的蒸馏允许坏人复制前沿人工智能能力（如高级编程或网络技能），同时剥离安全防范。攻击者通常会盯上模型的受保护推理，也就是模型在寻找答案时生成的内部思考链。为了应对这一问题，OpenAI 结合了对抗性训练、输入输出分类器以及严格的 API 级别保护。在 GPT-6.2 Astra 的测试中，从早期请求中提取推理的平均攻击成功率从 54.0% 降至 0.2%。此外，OpenAI 还开展了针对整个活动层面的调查，以打击有组织的提取尝试，并支持相关立法和出口管制以应对国家安全风险。

en.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Mini: A Looped AI Model You Can Run on Your Laptop
en.summary: According to Thinking Machines Lab: Inkling 2 Mini is a new **open-weights AI model** that features a looped transformer architecture, running its middle layers multiple times per token. This design allows it to perform complex reasoning efficiently and run directly on consumer laptops, while maintaining **strong monitorability** in its thinking process.
en.full_summary: According to Thinking Machines Lab: Inkling 2 Mini features 26.4 billion total parameters with 3.4 billion active, utilizing a looped transformer design where the middle layers are executed three times for every token. This architecture enables the model to achieve high-level reasoning and excel in agentic coding and knowledge-based tasks while keeping a compact memory footprint of around 20GB, making it capable of offline execution on devices like a MacBook Pro. Researchers evaluated its monitorability through a variable-loop variant and found that while looping increases internal computation without a verbalized chain of thought, it does not obscure the legibility of the model's reasoning or increase the risk of undetected agentic sabotage.

zh.title: Inkling 2 Mini 正式发布：能在笔记本上流畅运行的循环架构大模型
zh.summary: 据Thinking Machines Lab发布的信息：Inkling 2 Mini 是一款全新的**开源权重 AI 模型**，采用了创新的循环架构，通过让模型的中间层反复运行多次来提升推理能力。这种设计不仅让它能在普通消费级笔记本电脑上流畅运行，还能在处理复杂任务时保持良好的**可监控性**。
zh.full_summary: 据Thinking Machines Lab发布的信息：Inkling 2 Mini 拥有 264 亿总参数和 34 亿激活参数，其核心创新在于采用了循环变压器架构，让模型的中间层对每个词元重复运行三次。这种独特的处理方式使模型能够在不需要巨额参数规模的情况下，展现出极强的深度推理与长视野编程能力。由于其总内存占用约为 20GB，它能够直接在消费级笔记本电脑（如 MacBook Pro）上离线运行。研究人员通过专门的变量循环版本对其可监控性进行了测试，结果表明，尽管循环计算让模型在不写出思考过程的情况下思考得更久，但其思维链依然保持高度清晰，并未导致隐蔽恶意行为的增加。

en.title: Towards a Science of Capable Autonomous Agents & Provable Safety — Part II
en.summary: According to Carnegie Mellon ML Blog: CMU researchers explore provable guarantees for keeping capable autonomous agents corrigible, demonstrating that single-objective rewards like RLHF cannot guarantee corrigibility and introducing a lexicographic multi-utility framework.
en.full_summary: According to Carnegie Mellon ML Blog: In Part II of this series, the author addresses how to ensure capable autonomous agents remain open to human correction, even when intervention conflicts with task completion. Drawing on recent game-theoretic and complexity-theoretic results from AAAI 2026, the author proves that communication costs grow with the number of objectives and that reward hacking is inevitable under finite-sample estimation. To address why standard RLHF or single rewards fail to achieve corrigibility, the research presents sufficient conditions for satisfying corrigibility requirements in partially observable off-switch games by structuring five distinct utility heads with strict priority gaps (deference, switch preservation, truthfulness, low impact, and task reward). Furthermore, the author highlights empirical findings from the ROGUE benchmark, showing that LLM agents often fail to maintain safety constraints during ordinary computer use or delegation. Finally, the paper discusses 'sharding'—dividing evaluation criteria across separate model requests to prevent oversight overload.

zh.title: 迈向具备能力的自主智能体与可证明安全性科学（第二部分）
zh.summary: 据Carnegie Mellon ML Blog发布的信息：卡内基梅隆大学研究人员探讨了确保具能力自主智能体保持可纠正性的可证明保证，证明了RLHF等单目标奖励无法保证可纠正性，并引入了一个词典式的多效用框架。
zh.full_summary: 据Carnegie Mellon ML Blog发布的信息：在本文的第二部分中，作者探讨了如何确保具备能力的自主智能体在干预与任务完成冲突时，依然能够接受人类的纠正。结合AAAI 2026关于博弈论和复杂性理论的最新成果，作者证明了通信成本随目标数量增长，且在有限样本估计下奖励攻击是不可避免的。为了解释标准RLHF或单一奖励为何无法实现可纠正性，该研究在部分可观测的关闭开关博弈中，通过构建五个具有严格优先级鸿沟的效用头（顺从、开关保持、诚实、低影响、任务奖励），给出了满足可纠正性要求的充分条件。此外，作者重点介绍了ROGUE基准测试的实证发现，表明大语言模型智能体在日常计算机使用或任务委派过程中往往无法维持安全约束。最后，论文讨论了“分片”（sharding）技术——将评估标准分摊到独立的模型请求中，以防止监督过载。

en.title: Huawei Cloud releases CloudRobo-WM1.2, an Ascend-native embodied world model
en.summary: Huawei Cloud introduced **CloudRobo-WM1.2**, an embodied world model trained entirely on Huawei Ascend hardware. According to Huawei Cloud, the model achieved top rankings in the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Pro 2.0 benchmarks. Huawei Cloud plans to open source its weights, **inference code, and post-training code** on November 30 to help developers build and test robotic systems without starting from scratch.
en.full_summary:
Huawei Cloud announced its Ascend-native embodied world model, CloudRobo-WM1.2, which utilizes a multi-modal world representation architecture named PPA to combine perception, prediction, and action. According to Huawei Cloud, the model scored highest in RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Pro 2.0 benchmarks and outperformed peers in multi-robot real-world tests.

To address massive memory and compute demands, Huawei Cloud optimized the entire stack on Ascend hardware, including cluster communication, long-sequence data processing, and reinforcement learning frameworks developed with Tsinghua University. Huawei Cloud plans to release the model weights and training codes on November 30 and integrate partners through its CloudRobo platform.

zh.title: 华为云发布昇腾原生具身世界模型CloudRobo-WM1.2并计划开源
zh.summary: 华为云发布了基于国产昇腾算力训练的**具身世界模型CloudRobo-WM1.2**。据华为云称，该模型在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Pro 2.0两项评测中平均成功率排名第一。华为云计划在11月30日**开放模型权重及代码**，为机器人研发团队提供现成的训练链路与工具。
zh.full_summary:
华为云近日发布昇腾原生具身世界模型CloudRobo-WM1.2。该模型采用PPA多模态世界表征架构，将感知、预测和动作在同一阶段联合训练，使机器人能够更好地理解空间结构与物理交互结果。在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Pro 2.0评测中，该模型取得了平均成功率第一的成绩。

针对具身大模型面临的庞大显存与算力挑战，华为云围绕昇腾硬件进行了软硬件协同优化，包括长视频序列拆分、显存重计算以及联合清华大学适配强化学习框架。华为云计划于11月30日开源模型权重、推理及后训练代码，并通过CloudRobo平台和行业生态加速具身智能的产业落地。

en.title: GPT-6.2 Astra doubles robotics task success rate
en.summary: According to XDOF, OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra achieved a 41.2% success rate across 16 robot operating tasks, more than double its predecessor. The model notably cleared previously unpassed tasks like tying knots and unfolding T-shirts, showcasing major progress in handling soft objects and complex physical reasoning.
en.full_summary:
In recent tests conducted by robotics infrastructure firm XDOF, OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra demonstrated significant improvements in embodied AI tasks. Using six YAM workstations for parallel testing with strict controls to filter out hardware bias, XDOF found that GPT-6.2 Astra's average success rate across 16 standardized Ember-0 benchmark tasks rose from 19.6% to 41.2%. 

### Key Breakthroughs
The most notable achievement is the model's ability to successfully complete soft-object manipulation tasks such as tying knots and unfolding T-shirts, which previously had a 0% success rate across 143 trials. Sub-tasks requiring fine force control, spatial reasoning, and tool use, like picking up bread with a clip, also saw dramatic accuracy improvements from 10% to 90%.

### Speed and Industry Impact
Despite improvements in lowering the average prediction delay from 15 seconds to 10.1 seconds, latency remains a hurdle for real-time robotic response. Nevertheless, researchers including NUS Assistant Professor Jiafei Duan noted the model's exceptional performance in real-world benchmarks, underscoring how frontier multimodal models are rapidly accelerating physical world capabilities.

zh.title: GPT-6.2 Astra再次暴击具身模型：任务成功率翻倍
zh.summary: 据机器人基础设施公司XDOF实测，OpenAI的GPT-6.2 Astra在16项双臂机器人操作任务中的综合成功率达到41.2%，较两个月前的版本翻倍。该模型首次攻克了**打结和展开T恤**等此前无AI通关的难题，显示出大模型在**处理柔性物体**和复杂物理推理方面的显著进步。
zh.full_summary:
根据机器人基础设施公司XDOF的最新实测，OpenAI的GPT-6.2 Astra在具身智能领域再次取得突破。XDOF采用六台YAM工作站进行并行试验，通过严格的重复测试与人工标注，排除了硬件偏差，结果显示GPT-6.2 Astra在16项Ember-0基准任务中的综合成功率从两个月前的19.6%飙升至41.2%。

### 关键技术突破
该模型最引人注目的成就在于成功攻克了**给绳子打结和展开T恤**这两项此前无AI通关的零分任务。由于柔性物体形态多变且难以预测，这类任务对双臂协同和形变控制要求极高。此外，在用夹子夹起面包等考验精细力控的子任务中，成功率也从10%大幅提升至90%。

### 性能与行业影响
在速度方面，GPT-6.2 Astra的平均预测延迟从15秒下降至10.1秒，但对于实时机器人操作而言仍有优化空间。新加坡国立大学助理教授Jiafei Duan等学者的实测也表明，该模型在真实机器人竞技场中表现优异，显示出前沿大模型正在加速向物理世界渗透。

en.title: How Developers Use Frontier AI Agents to Build Simulations in NVIDIA Omniverse
en.summary: According to NVIDIA Robotics: NVIDIA details how developers are combining **frontier AI models** with Omniverse libraries to build and test simulations. By directing AI agents through natural-language prompts, engineers can quickly turn 3D assets, CAD data, and site scans into functional digital twins for **robotics testing**, industrial automation, and virtual reality workflows.
en.full_summary:
According to NVIDIA Robotics:

NVIDIA highlights a series of developer projects demonstrating how frontier AI models and Omniverse libraries are transforming simulation workflows. Engineers and developers are using natural-language instructions to guide AI agents in assembling 3D assets, configuring physics engines, and running tests across diverse domains.

Key examples include building facility-scale digital twins from engineering data, creating robot pick-and-place simulations using standardized asset libraries, and testing humanoids and robotic cable-routing tasks in virtual environments. Developers also report challenges, noting that automated tests sometimes miss tactile issues like object shaking, which require manual inspection and prompt adjustments to resolve.

These workflows leverage OpenUSD frameworks and specialized Omniverse libraries to connect rendering, physics, and sensor simulation, enabling teams to evaluate industrial operations and autonomous systems before deploying them in the physical world.

zh.title: 开发者如何利用前沿AI智能体在NVIDIA Omniverse中构建各类仿真
zh.summary: 据NVIDIA Robotics发布的信息：NVIDIA 详细介绍了开发者如何将**前沿AI模型**与 Omniverse 库结合来构建和测试仿真。工程师通过自然语言指令引导AI智能体，能快速将3D资产、CAD数据和现场扫描件转化为功能完备的数字孪生，用于**机器人测试**、工业自动化和虚拟现实工作流。
zh.full_summary:
据NVIDIA Robotics发布的信息：

NVIDIA 展示了一系列开发者项目，阐述了前沿AI模型与 Omniverse 库如何改变仿真工作流。工程师和开发者通过自然语言指令引导AI智能体，完成3D资产组装、物理引擎配置以及跨领域的各项测试。

主要案例包括利用工程数据构建工厂级数字孪生、使用标准化资产库创建机器人抓放仿真，以及在虚拟环境中测试人形机器人和机器人理线任务。开发者同时也指出了一些挑战，例如自动化测试有时会遗漏物体晃动等触觉问题，需要人工检查并调整提示词来解决。

这些工作流利用了 OpenUSD 框架和专门的 Omniverse 库来连接渲染、物理和传感器仿真，使团队能够在将工业运营和自动驾驶系统部署到现实世界之前对其进行评估。

en.title: New approach enables physically consistent AI models of chaotic systems
en.summary: According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing: Researchers at MIT have developed a new method to add **physics-based hard constraints** to machine learning models, ensuring they do not drift into impossible predictions over time. Published in *PNAS*, this approach uses **energy-based restrictions** to keep chaotic systems like weather and fluid dynamics within realistic bounds, offering a reliable way to improve AI reliability in high-stakes fields.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing:

### Background
Predicting complex and chaotic systems like weather patterns, ocean currents, and turbulent flows is notoriously difficult. While artificial intelligence models can learn from data, they often suffer from a fundamental flaw: **small initial errors accumulate over time**, causing simulations to drift into physically impossible states where values grow without limit.

### Details
According to MIT researchers Sunbochen Tang, Navid Azizan, and Themistoklis Sapsis, previous attempts relied on soft penalties during training, which offered no guarantee at test time. The team’s new approach introduces a **projection layer** that enforces hard constraints based on real-world energy dissipation. The model learns an energy-like function and a confinement boundary, ensuring that predictions remain **bounded over arbitrarily long forecast windows** while still preserving complex chaotic behaviors.

### Impact
Tested across various physical systems, the modular and model-agnostic approach closely matched true outcomes compared to conventional methods. The team has made their code and paper freely available online, paving the way for more trustworthy and reliable AI applications in meteorology, aviation, and industrial processes.

zh.title: MIT 研究让 AI 预测混沌系统不再“走样”
zh.summary: 据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种新方法，能给机器学习模型加上**物理硬性约束**，防止它们在长时间预测时出现不切实际的偏差。这项发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）上的成果，利用**能量守恒原理**将天气和流体力学等混沌系统锁定在合理范围内，显著提升了 AI 在高风险领域的可靠性。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：

### 背景
预测天气、洋流和航空湍流等复杂且混沌的系统一直非常困难。尽管人工智能模型能够从数据中学习，但它们普遍存在一个根本缺陷：**微小的初始误差会随时间累积**，导致模拟结果演变成现实中不可能发生的无限增长状态。

### 细节
据麻省理工学院的研究生 Sunbochen Tang 以及教授 Navid Azizan 和 Themistoklis Sapsis 介绍，以往的方法仅在训练阶段施加惩罚，无法在测试时提供保证。该团队开发的新方法引入了一个**投影层**，根据现实世界的能量耗散来强制执行硬约束。模型会学习一个类能量函数和边界，从而确保预测结果在**任意长的预测窗口内保持在合理范围内**，同时保留复杂的混沌特性。

### 影响
经过多种物理系统的测试，这种模块化且与模型无关的方法比传统方法更贴近真实结果。该团队已将论文和开源代码在线公开，为气象、航空和工业流程中更值得信赖的 AI 应用铺平了道路。

en.title: AI model connects molecular structures and spectra in any direction
en.summary: According to Lila Sciences: Researchers at Lila Sciences have developed an AI model called MOSAIC that treats molecular structures and different spectral measurements as interchangeable. By enabling **any-to-any generation**, the model can predict molecular structures from spectra with **88.8% accuracy** in experiments, outperforming baseline methods by over 20%.
en.full_summary:
According to Lila Sciences:

## Background and Method
In March 2026, AI researchers Thorben Prein and Elton Pan at Lila Sciences identified a gap in materials science AI: most models only translate between molecular structures and spectra in a single direction. To solve this, they developed MOSAIC, an **any-to-any method** accepted for the NeurIPS 2026 conference. The approach combines infrared, UV, and Raman spectral modalities alongside molecular structures, treating all four data types as interchangeable viewpoints of the same molecule, much like multiple people describing an elephant from different angles.

## Performance and Validation
In experiments, MOSAIC predicted correct molecular structures from spectra **88.8% of the time**, significantly outperforming traditional baselines. Independent expert Kevin Maik Jablonka noted that while the method tackles an important problem by combining evidence sources, future work must demonstrate its effectiveness on complex mixtures and noisy experimental data rather than just pure, small molecules.

## Future Outlook
The researchers plan to scale the model using more simulated and proprietary lab data through industry partnerships. They believe this **multimodal flow matching** approach could eventually generalize to drug design and renewable energy materials, helping scientists reduce experiments, lower costs, and speed up discovery.

zh.title: AI 新模型实现分子结构与光谱的任意方向自由转换
zh.summary: 据Lila Sciences发布的信息：Lila Sciences 的研究人员开发了一种名为 MOSAIC 的人工智能模型，能够将分子结构与不同的光谱测量数据进行双向甚至多向互换。通过实现**任意方向生成**，该模型在实验中从光谱预测分子结构的准确率达到了 **88.8%**，比基线方法高出 20% 以上。
zh.full_summary:
据Lila Sciences发布的信息：

## 背景与方法
2026 年 3 月，Lila Sciences 的研究人员 Thorben Prein 和 Elton Pan 发现材料科学领域的 AI 工具普遍存在局限：大多数模型只能单向在分子结构和光谱之间转换。为此，他们开发了名为 MOSAIC 的模型，该成果已被 NeurIPS 2026 录用。该方法将红外、紫外、拉曼光谱以及分子结构等四种数据类型视为互通的视角，实现了**任意方向生成**，就像盲人摸象一样，通过结合多个角度来全面理解分子。

## 表现与验证
在实验中，MOSAIC 从光谱预测正确分子结构的准确率达到了 **88.8%**，大幅超越传统基线方法。德国耶拿大学的专家凯文·麦克·雅布隆卡（Kevin Maik Jablonka）评价称，该研究通过整合不同证据源解决了一个重要难题，但未来仍需证明其在复杂混合物和真实噪声数据上的有效性。
更多详情表明，该研究为解决化学中的正向和反向预测问题提供了新思路。

## 未来展望
研究团队计划通过与行业合作伙伴开展合作，引入更多模拟数据和实验室专有数据来提升模型性能。团队认为这种**多模态流匹配**方法未来有望扩展到药物设计和新能源材料领域，从而帮助科学家减少实验次数、降低成本并加速研发进程。

en.title: MIT engineers develop dry, stretchy material to replace ultrasound gel
en.summary: According to MIT Materials: Researchers at MIT have created a **dry and stretchy** material that replaces the sticky, wet gel traditionally required for ultrasound imaging. Because conventional gels dry out quickly, they are poorly suited for long-term wearable health monitoring. This new liquid-free material **transmits ultrasound waves** efficiently and remains stable for days, opening the door for continuous medical imaging during everyday activities.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Materials:

## Background
Ultrasound imaging normally requires a cold, wet gel spread on the patient's skin to fill microscopic gaps and help sound waves travel smoothly. While MIT's Zhao Lab is designing wearable ultrasound patches for continuous health tracking, traditional hydrogels dry out within a day or two, limiting their long-term use outside of clinics.

## Details
To solve this, the MIT team engineered a solid, rubbery material using a unique molecular "bottlebrush" structure. By arranging molecules like pipe cleaners with bristles, the team minimized internal friction between polymer chains so sound waves could pass through easily. They reinforced this soft structure with a secondary network, making it **tough and skin-like** while keeping its sound-transmitting properties intact.

## Impact
In experiments published in *Science*, a small wearable patch using this dry material successfully captured **continuous, clear ultrasound images** of a volunteer's blood flow during a 30-minute bike ride and remained stable for nine days. This breakthrough could soon enable practical, at-home ultrasound monitoring for patients and athletes without the hassle of sticky gels.

zh.title: 麻省理工学院开发出替代超声耦合剂的干爽高弹新材料
zh.summary: 据MIT Materials发布的信息：麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种**干爽且具有弹性**的新材料，可以用来替代传统B超检查时必不可少的湿冷耦合剂。由于传统耦合剂干得很快，不适合长时间佩戴的健康监测设备。这种全新的无液材料能够高效**传输超声波**，并且在数天内保持稳定，为日常活动中的持续医学成像铺平了道路。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Materials发布的信息：

## 背景介绍
做B超检查时，医生通常要在皮肤上涂一层湿冷的耦合剂，用来填补皮肤和探头之间的微小空隙，让超声波顺利穿透。虽然麻省理工学院的赵选贺团队一直在设计用于持续健康追踪的可穿戴超声贴片，但传统的凝胶在几天内就会变干，这限制了它在医院之外的长期使用。

## 技术细节
为了解决这个问题，研究团队利用独特的分子“瓶刷”结构，研发出了一种固态橡胶状新材料。这种分子结构就像刷子一样带有侧链，能够大幅减少聚合物分子链之间的内部摩擦，从而让超声波顺畅通过。他们通过第二层网络增强了这种柔软的材料，使其**坚韧且贴合皮肤**，同时保留了优秀的传音性能。

## 实际影响
根据发表在《科学》杂志上的实验，研究人员将这种干爽材料制成小型可穿戴贴片，贴在志愿者颈部，成功在30分钟的骑行过程中**持续记录清晰的血流超声图像**，并且性能能够稳定维持九天。这项突破有望让未来人们在家里或运动时，也能摆脱黏糊糊的凝胶，轻松进行长时间的超声监测。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod adds managed cluster extensions for Slurm
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon announced **cluster extensions** for SageMaker HyperPod Slurm clusters, introducing **managed software packages** that simplify observability and user management. Instead of relying on manual lifecycle scripts, administrators can now **declaratively manage** software configurations through APIs or the console to keep nodes consistent and healthy.
en.full_summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Maintaining a shared Slurm cluster for foundation model development has traditionally required synchronizing multiple configuration files, custom scripts, and user rosters across nodes. To address configuration drift, Amazon SageMaker HyperPod has expanded its declarative management approach to running nodes. The newly launched cluster extensions currently support two main capabilities: an observability extension that collects metrics for CloudWatch or Prometheus, and a user management extension that handles local accounts, Active Directory integration, SSH access, and Slurm accounting. These extensions are validated up front against schemas, applied consistently to all nodes including newly scaled or replaced instances, and provide detailed health monitoring without requiring fleet-wide script updates.

zh.title: 亚马逊云科技为 SageMaker HyperPod Slurm 集群推出托管集群扩展功能
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊近日为 SageMaker HyperPod Slurm 集群推出了**集群扩展**功能，带来了用于简化可观测性和用户管理的**托管软件包**。管理员无需再依赖手动生命周期脚本，而是可以通过 API 或控制台进行**声明式管理**软件配置，从而确保所有节点保持一致且健康。
zh.full_summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：过去，为大模型开发维护一个共享的 Slurm 集群，需要在各个节点之间同步多份配置文件、自定义脚本和用户花名册。为了解决配置漂移的问题，Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 将其声明式管理模式扩展到了运行中的节点。新推出的集群扩展目前支持两大核心功能：一是负责收集指标并发送至 CloudWatch 或 Prometheus 的可观测性扩展，二是处理本地账户、活动目录集成、SSH 访问权限以及 Slurm 计费的用户管理扩展。这些扩展在提交时会通过架构进行预先验证，能够一致地应用到包括新扩容或替换实例在内的所有节点，并在无需更新全集群脚本的情况下提供详细的健康监控。

en.title: Depth Pro 2: Apple researchers introduce AI model for sharp and stable video depth estimation
en.summary: According to Apple Machine Learning: Researchers introduce **Depth Pro 2**, an AI approach that estimates metric depth from images and video at full resolution. Traditional methods usually struggle to balance **temporal stability** and boundary sharpness, but this model successfully achieves both simultaneously while maintaining metric accuracy and releasing open weights.
en.full_summary:
According to Apple Machine Learning:

## Background
Estimating depth from a single image or video using a regular camera has long forced a compromise. Single-frame methods usually produce sharp edges, but jump around annoyingly from frame to frame in video. Multi-frame methods stay steady, but often blur out fine details.

## Details
According to the authors, Depth Pro 2 trains a **single scalable network** that handles individual photos, full videos, or live camera feeds at native resolution. It predicts dense metric depth in actual meters without sacrificing either **edge sharpness** or frame-to-frame consistency.

## Impact
The team has released a family of models along with their code and weights, establishing a new performance benchmark for **metric depth estimation** that can run efficiently across different media types.

zh.title: 苹果发布 Depth Pro 2：让普通视频和照片拥有清晰稳定的深度信息
zh.summary: 据Apple Machine Learning发布的信息：研究人员推出了 **Depth Pro 2**，这是一种能直接从普通图片和视频中计算出真实距离的 AI 技术。过去的类似技术往往很难同时做到**画面稳定**和边缘清晰，而该模型成功攻克了这个难题，并且已经开源了相关代码和权重。
zh.full_summary:
据Apple Machine Learning发布的信息：

## 背景与痛点
用普通的相机拍照片或视频并直接算出每个像素的远近，一直是计算机视觉领域的难题。过去的方法往往左右为难：单帧处理能把物体边缘做得**非常锐利**，但在视频里就会一闪一闪不稳定；多帧处理虽然稳当了，却又容易把细节糊掉。

## 技术细节
据作者团队介绍，Depth Pro 2 训练了一个**统一的可扩展网络**，能够直接处理单张照片、完整视频甚至是实时摄像头画面，并且支持输入画面的原分辨率。它输出的深度信息不仅带有实际的物理单位（米），还能同时兼顾**边缘清晰度**和视频帧与帧之间的稳定性。

## 行业影响
研究团队目前已经公开了该系列模型的代码和权重，为**深度估计**技术树立了兼顾精度、速度和稳定性的新标杆，未来有望广泛应用于三维重建和视觉特效等领域。

en.title: Chinese Team Wins 2026 Gordon Bell Prize for Exascale Nitrogen Fixation Simulation
en.summary: A 10-member team from Chinese institutions has won the **2026 ACM Gordon Bell Prize** for developing the first classical solution at **exascale** for a key nitrogen fixation simulation. The researchers modeled the iron-molybdenum cofactor on two Chinese supercomputers, achieving a sustained 1.456 exaflops in double precision.
en.full_summary:
According to the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), the 10-member team received the prestigious Gordon Bell Prize during the SC26 conference in Chicago for their project titled 'Closing the FeMo-Cofactor Quantum-Advantage Gap with Exascale Supercomputers.' The Gordon Bell Prize recognizes outstanding achievements in applying high-performance computing to complex scientific and engineering problems.

The team focused on the FeMo Cofactor CAS problem, which involves simulating the complex quantum-level interactions of the iron-molybdenum cofactor that helps enzymes convert nitrogen into ammonia—a crucial process for agriculture and biology. Prior to this, classical computers struggled to simulate these intricate electronic behaviors at scale.

To tackle this, the researchers tuned their simulation code for two advanced Chinese supercomputers, LineShine and China's New-generation Intelligent Super-computer (CNIS). According to their paper's abstract, the team achieved a sustained performance of 1.456 exaflops in double precision across 20,480 nodes on LineShine, utilizing 58.9% of the machine's peak capacity, alongside 5.626 exaflops in mixed precision.

zh.title: 中国科研团队斩获 2026 年戈登·贝尔奖，实现百亿亿次超算模拟突破
zh.summary: 由中国科研机构组成的 10 人团队荣获 **2026 年 ACM 戈登·贝尔奖**，他们在百亿亿次超级计算机上首次实现了对固氮关键成分的**经典计算模拟**。该团队通过优化代码，在国产超算上达到了双精度每秒 145.6 京次的持续计算性能。
zh.full_summary:
根据国际计算机协会（ACM）的消息，这支由 10 名中国学者组成的团队在芝加哥举行的 SC26 大会上被授予 **2026 年 ACM 戈登·贝尔奖**。该奖项旨在表彰利用高性能计算解决科学与工程难题的杰出创新成果，此次获奖项目聚焦于在超算上弥补铁钼辅因子计算的“量子优势”差距。

该团队的研究直面生物化学中的固氮难题，即模拟铁钼辅因子如何帮助酶将氮气转化为氨。由于这一过程涉及复杂的原子、分子和量子级电子状态交互，传统模拟难度极高。理解该机制有望为农业和医药等多个领域带来深远启发。

为了攻克这一难题，研究人员针对两台国产超算——LineShine 和新一代智能超算（CNIS）对代码进行了深度调优。根据论文摘要显示，他们在 LineShine 的 20,480 个计算节点上，实现了双精度下 **1.456 exaflops** 的持续计算性能，达到了机器峰值的 58.9%，混合精度下更是达到了 5.626 exaflops。

en.title: Li Auto built a chip that made it to TSMC's stage, but wants you to totally forget about it while driving
en.summary: Li Auto has developed its proprietary "Mach M100" AI chip using a dynamic dataflow architecture, achieving high compute utilization. The company shared its design at TSMC's OIP Forum. This self-developed chip tackles the memory wall problem to power advanced vision-language-action driving models, aiming to make assisted driving feel smoother and more human-like.
en.full_summary: Traditional chips struggle with AI workloads due to the von Neumann architecture bottleneck, where data is constantly shuttled back and forth between processors and memory, wasting a huge portion of compute power. Li Auto's Mach M100 replaces this with a dynamic dataflow architecture that streamlines data processing directly across computing units. Built on a 5nm automotive-grade process, the 1280 TOPS chip achieves over 82% compute utilization. This high efficiency allows vehicles to run advanced AI models and native 3D visual encoders smoothly, removing the hesitation and jerks often found in traditional smart driving systems.

zh.title: 理想造了一颗登上台积电讲台的芯片，却希望你在开车时彻底忘掉它
zh.summary: 理想汽车发布并量产了自研的“马赫 M100”AI 芯片，凭借独特的动态数据流架构登上了台积电 OIP 论坛。这颗芯片通过打破传统的“内存墙”瓶颈，大幅提升了算力利用率，为车端的智能驾驶大模型提供底层支撑，让车辆在路上的反应变得更加流畅自然。
zh.full_summary: 过去几十年，传统的芯片架构在面对 AI 大模型计算时，常常会因为数据在处理器与内存之间频繁搬运而遭遇效率瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，理想在 2022 年立项并研发了马赫 M100 芯片，放弃了传统的架构路线，把芯片内部改造成类似中央厨房的高效流水线。这颗采用 5nm 工艺、算力达 1280 TOPS 的车规级芯片，将算力利用率拉升到了 82% 以上。凭借这套底层的算力支撑，理想将自研的 3D 视觉编码器和 VLA 驾驶大模型搬上了车端，让汽车在面对复杂路况时能够像人类一样快速做出果断的驾驶决策。

en.title: China grid-connects world’s first artificial-cavern CAES plant
en.summary: China has successfully connected the **Yuanchu No. 1** compressed air energy storage station to the grid in Yumen, Gansu province. Developed by China Energy Engineering Corporation, the **300 MW/1,800 MWh** facility utilizes purpose-excavated underground hard-rock chambers rather than natural salt caverns, expanding potential sites for large-scale energy storage.
en.full_summary:
The Yuanchu No. 1 compressed air energy storage station in Yumen, Gansu province, achieved its first grid connection on November 16. Developed by China Energy Digital Technology Group, a subsidiary of China Energy Engineering Corporation, the facility represents a notable shift in **compressed-air storage** technology by moving beyond traditional reliance on natural salt caverns.

The plant features a **300 MW/1,800 MWh** capacity, designed for an eight-hour charging cycle and six hours of discharge, with a total investment of approximately CNY 2.5 billion. Its defining innovation is four interconnected storage chambers excavated roughly 110 meters deep into hard rock, creating a pressurized space of about 200,000 cubic meters with a design pressure of 18 MPa.

The facility employs non-combustion, adiabatic CAES technology, utilizing a thermal system that combines low-melting-point ternary molten salt and pressurized hot water to recover and store compression heat without burning natural gas. While the developer reports a **round-trip efficiency** of 72%, sustained long-term operational data and independent verification are still needed to confirm its economic viability and cavern integrity.

zh.title: 中国并网运行全球首座人工硐室压缩空气储能电站
zh.summary: 中国在甘肃玉门成功并网了**源创一号**压缩空气储能电站。该项目由中国能源建设集团开发，规模达到**300兆瓦/1800兆瓦时**，它首次采用人工开挖的地下硬岩硐室而非天然盐穴来存储压缩空气，从而拓宽了大规模储能的选址空间。
zh.full_summary:
位于甘肃玉门的源创一号压缩空气储能电站于11月16日成功实现首次并网。该项目由中国能建旗下的中国能源数字科技集团投资、建设和运营，标志着**压缩空气储能**技术突破了对天然盐穴地质条件的依赖。

该电站规模为**300兆瓦/1800兆瓦时**，设计充电周期为8小时，连续放电6小时，总投资约25亿元人民币。其核心创新在于地下110米深的硬岩中开挖了四个互联的储气硐室，总容积约20万立方米，设计压力达18兆帕。

技术上，该电站采用无燃烧的绝热压缩空气储能系统，利用低熔点三元熔盐和加压热水回收并储存压缩热，无需燃烧天然气。尽管开发商报告其**综合电效率**达到72%，但其长期运行效率、硐室完整性以及经济性仍需未来的实际运行数据来进一步验证。

en.title: Merck and Kelun's new cancer drug succeeds in stomach cancer trial
en.summary: Merck announced that its jointly developed drug with Kelun-Biotech, sac-TMT, successfully improved **overall survival** in a late-stage stomach cancer trial, marking its second major Phase 3 milestone. Although it missed other secondary goals, experts note that overall survival remains the **gold standard** in oncology, paving the way for future regulatory submissions.
en.full_summary:
According to Merck, the Phase 3 clinical trial known as TroFuse-015 evaluated 473 patients with advanced gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma who had previously received multiple therapies. The drug, a TROP2-targeting antibody-drug conjugate originally discovered by China startup Kelun-Biotech, successfully met its primary endpoint by significantly improving overall survival compared to standard treatments chosen by physicians. However, the trial missed secondary endpoints including progression-free survival and objective response rate. Market analysts point out that missing these secondary goals is not uncommon in cancer immunotherapies as long as the primary survival metric succeeds. 

This trial is part of a broad global clinical program featuring 18 late-stage studies across various tumor types. The therapy is also under priority review by the U.S. FDA for endometrial cancer and has secured approvals in China for multiple indications. Financial analysts view this drug as a critical asset for Merck to offset future revenue risks from its blockbuster drug Keytruda. Merck initially partnered with Kelun in 2022 through lucrative licensing deals worth billions to secure rights to these promising antibody-drug conjugates.

zh.title: 默沙东与科伦合作的新型抗癌药在胃癌三期临床试验中取得生存期延长成果
zh.summary: 默沙东宣布，其与科伦生物医药合作研发的新药sac-TMT在一项晚期胃癌临床试验中成功延长了患者的**总体生存期**，这是该药全球三期临床计划的又一重大进展。尽管该试验未达到其他次要目标，但业内专家指出，总体生存期依然是肿瘤学中的**黄金标准**，为未来的监管申报打下了基础。
zh.full_summary:
据默沙东称，这项名为TroFuse-015的三期临床试验评估了473名接受过多次系统治疗的晚期胃肠道腺癌患者。该药物是一种靶向TROP2的抗体偶联药物，最初由中国初创企业科伦生物医药发现，它通过与医生选择的传统疗法进行对比，成功达到了显著改善**总体生存期**的主要临床终点。不过，该试验未达到无进展生存期和客观缓解率等次要终点。市场分析人士指出，在癌症免疫疗法中，只要核心的生存指标达成，未达到部分次要目标并不罕见。

该胃癌试验是横跨多种肿瘤类型的18项全球三期临床研究计划的一部分。目前，该疗法正在接受美国食品药品监督管理局针对子宫内膜癌的优先审评，并在中国获批了多项适应症。金融分析师认为，这款药物是默沙东用来对冲其王牌药物Keytruda未来专利到期带来的**收入风险**的关键资产。默沙东在2022年通过价值数十亿美元的重磅授权交易，从科伦手中获得了这些潜力抗体偶联药物的开发权益。

en.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in Tests of Teamwork
en.summary: Google Quantum AI researchers used their **Willow processor** to show that quantum contextuality can outperform classical strategies in cooperative games. The chip won a four-qubit game 98.3% of the time, beating the classical limit, and successfully scaled past classical limits with up to **71 qubits**, offering a new method to detect hardware errors.
en.full_summary:
## Cooperative Games and Quantum Contextuality
Researchers at Google Quantum AI utilized the Willow processor to investigate quantum contextuality, a property where measurement outcomes depend on accompanying measurements. In a magic square game preventing player communication, **four qubits** achieved a 98.3% winning rate, surpassing the 88.9% classical limit.

## Scaling Up to 71 Qubits
The team scaled the experiments using a Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state. The winning rate stayed above the classical ceiling through **71 players**, although the performance margin shrank as more qubits were introduced due to experimental noise.

## Mathematical Problem and Error Detection
In a final test involving a two-dimensional hidden linear function, a **105-qubit experiment** returned valid answers more than half the time. The researchers note that these tests can help spot subtle hardware errors that conventional checks might miss.

zh.title: 谷歌量子芯片在团队合作测试中超越经典极限
zh.summary: 谷歌量子团队利用其 **Willow 处理器** 证明，量子上下文性可以在合作游戏中超越经典计算机的策略。该芯片在四量子比特游戏中取得了 98.3% 的胜率，打破了经典极限，并在最多 **71 个量子比特** 的协作测试中成功超越传统上限，为检测硬件错误提供了一种新方法。
zh.full_summary:
## 合作游戏与量子上下文性
谷歌量子人工智能团队利用 Willow 处理器研究了量子上下文性，即测量结果取决于同时进行的其它测量。在一项禁止玩家交流的魔方格游戏中，**四个量子比特** 实现了 98.3% 的胜率，超过了 88.9% 的经典限制。

## 扩展至 71 个量子比特
研究团队使用格林伯格-霍恩-齐林格状态扩展了实验。通过多达 **71 个玩家** 的协作，胜率依然保持在经典上限之上，不过随着量子比特的增加，由于实验噪声，性能差距有所缩小。

## 数学问题与错误检测
在涉及二维隐藏线性函数的最终测试中，**105 个量子比特的实验** 在半数以上的时间里返回了有效答案。研究人员指出，这些测试有助于发现常规检查可能漏掉的微小硬件错误。

en.title: LangSmith Launches Tool Gateway for Secure Agent Actions
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: LangSmith has launched **Tool Gateway** in public beta to help engineering teams securely manage agent tool calls. According to the company, the new managed layer handles **credentials and identity**, allowing agents to run with user permissions or service accounts while logging **every action** for compliance and debugging.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

## Background and Challenges
As AI agents move beyond simple chat windows to run autonomously on schedules or in the background, they require access to external tools and systems. According to LangSmith, managing identities, access tokens, and security for hundreds of tools across multiple users creates a massive engineering burden and introduces security risks when handled manually.

## Core Features
Tool Gateway acts as a single managed layer routing tool requests through a unified URL. It manages **identity resolution**, mapping tool calls to either the individual user's credentials or dedicated agent profiles. Additionally, it offers **policy controls** such as deny rules and human-in-the-loop approvals for sensitive actions, alongside built-in servers for common apps like Google and GitHub to eliminate custom OAuth setups.

## Impact and Visibility
Every tool call is recorded within agent traces, logging the specific tool, server, user, latency, and outcome without storing sensitive payload data. Enterprise plans also include **centralized audit logs**, giving security teams a clear, unified record to answer compliance questions and debug production issues faster.

zh.title: LangSmith 推出工具网关，保障 AI 代理安全调用
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：LangSmith 推出处于公测阶段的**工具网关**，帮助工程团队安全管理 AI 代理的工具调用。据该公司介绍，这一托管层负责处理**凭证与身份**，让代理能够以用户权限或服务账号运行，同时记录**每一次操作**以便合规审计和调试。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

## 背景与挑战
随着 AI 代理从简单的聊天窗口走向自主定时或后台运行，它们需要访问外部工具和系统。据 LangSmith 称，在多用户环境下为数百个工具手动管理身份、访问令牌和安全性会带来沉重的工程负担，并引发安全风险。

## 核心功能
工具网关作为一个统一的托管层，通过单一网址路由工具请求。它负责**身份解析**，将工具调用映射到个人用户的凭证或专属代理配置文件。此外，它还提供**策略控制**（如拒绝规则和敏感操作的人机协同审批），并内置了针对谷歌、GitHub 等常用应用的服务器，免去了编写自定义授权的麻烦。

## 影响与可见性
每次工具调用都会被记录在代理追踪中，记录具体的工具、服务器、用户、延迟和结果，同时不会存储敏感的负载数据。企业版还包含**集中式审计日志**，为安全团队提供清晰、统一的记录，以便回答合规问题并更快地调试生产环境中的问题。

en.title: Clearing Cellular Traffic Jams Treats Multiple Diseases in Mice
en.summary: According to Broad Institute: Researchers at the Broad Institute have discovered a shared biological mechanism behind **multiple genetic diseases** caused by misfolded proteins. By targeting a specific molecular complex that gets jammed in cells, they successfully **cleared disease hallmarks** in mouse models of both kidney disease and blindness, opening a potential path to treat millions of patients with similar conditions.
en.full_summary:
According to Broad Institute:

According to researchers at the Broad Institute publishing in _Neuron_, a group of over 50 inherited disorders known as proteinopathies share a common root cause: **misfolded proteins** accumulating inside cells and overwhelming the cellular quality-control machinery.

Building on their previous work on TMED9 in MUC1 kidney disease, the team found that TMED2, 7, 9, and 10 form a **protein complex** that traps these misfolded proteins and causes a cellular traffic jam. By deleting or targeting a key component of this complex called **TMED7**, scientists were able to release the trapped proteins to be recycled without disrupting normal cellular functions, successfully reversing disease hallmarks in mice with MUC1 kidney disease and slowing vision loss in a model of retinitis pigmentosa.

zh.title: 疏通细胞“交通堵塞”可在小鼠身上治疗多种疾病
zh.summary: 据Broad Institute发布的信息：博德研究所的研究人员发现了一个由蛋白质折叠错误引发的**多种遗传疾病**的共同生物学机制。通过靶向细胞中堵塞的特定分子复合物，他们在肾病和小鼠失明模型中成功**清除了疾病标志**，为治疗数百万患有同类疾病的患者开辟了潜在途径。
zh.full_summary:
据Broad Institute发布的信息：

据博德研究所的研究人员在《Neuron》期刊上发表的论文显示，超过50种被称为蛋白质病的遗传性疾病都有一个共同的根源：**折叠错误的蛋白质**在细胞内积聚，压垮了细胞的质量控制系统。

在前期关于MUC1肾病中TMED9研究的基础上，研究团队发现TMED2、7、9和10共同构成了一个**蛋白质复合物**，会困住这些错误折叠的蛋白质并导致细胞交通堵塞。通过删除或靶向该复合物中的一个关键成分**TMED7**，科学家们能够在不干扰正常细胞功能的情况下，释放被困蛋白质进行回收，从而成功逆转了患有MUC1肾病小鼠的疾病特征，并延缓了视网膜色素变性小鼠模型的视力丧失。

en.title: AWS Quick updates bring multi-agent workflows and web app upgrades
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: AWS announces major updates to Quick, its workplace AI tool, featuring **natural language flow building**, a redesigned web app with background task execution, and **multi-agent orchestration**. The release also adds Meta Ads and Amplitude connectors, improved security controls, and support for additional languages.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

AWS has rolled out a comprehensive update to its enterprise AI workspace, AWS Quick, designed to help teams operationalize individual workflows and collaborate more efficiently. Key features include conversational process building, where users can describe business tasks in chat to automatically generate deterministic flows that orchestrate agents, tools, and data. The updated web app features a prioritized home screen feed, a daily briefing, and background task processing that lets users close the browser while agents continue working.

Additionally, AWS Quick now supports multi-agent orchestration, enabling a single prompt to summon several specialized agents simultaneously to handle complex requests and combine their findings. New enterprise data connectors for Meta Ads and Amplitude allow users to pull marketing and product behavioral data into their queries. Administrative controls have also been expanded with prompt guardrails, group-level permissions, and data source restrictions, alongside new language support for Japanese, German, Chinese, and Vietnamese.

zh.title: 亚马逊 AWS Quick AI 工作空间迎来多项更新，支持多智能体协作与网页端工作流
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊近日宣布对其 AI 工作空间工具 AWS Quick 进行重大更新，主要带来**自然语言构建工作流**、支持后台运行的全新网页应用，以及**多智能体协同**功能。此次更新还接入了 Meta Ads 和 Amplitude 数据源，并增强了安全控制与多语言支持。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

亚马逊为其企业级 AI 工作空间 AWS Quick 推出了全面更新，旨在帮助团队将个人的日常工作流程标准化并提升协作效率。核心亮点包括通过对话构建业务流程，用户只需在聊天中描述任务，系统即可自动生成可编排智能体、工具和数据的确定性工作流。更新后的网页端应用提供了优化的主屏幕信息流、每日简报，以及允许用户关闭浏览器后任务仍在后台继续运行的功能。

此外，AWS Quick 现在支持多智能体协同，用户通过单个提示词就能同时唤醒多个专业智能体来处理复杂请求并整合结果。新推出的 Meta Ads 和 Amplitude 数据源连接器允许用户将营销与产品行为数据直接纳入查询中。在管理和安全方面，AWS Quick 增加了提示词安全防护网、基于用户组的权限控制以及数据源限制，并新增支持日语、德语、中英文及越南语。

en.title: Google brings Duplex AI calling to the Gemini app
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google reports that it has integrated its **Duplex AI calling** technology into the Gemini app, allowing users to have an AI assistant make phone calls to businesses on their behalf. According to Google, this evolution builds on a decade-long architectural shift from early custom neural networks to a **unified Gemini stack** capable of handling open-ended conversational tasks in noisy real-world environments.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

According to Google, the architecture behind its conversational calling features has evolved through three distinct phases over the past ten years. In the pre-LLM era, the system relied on task-specific recurrent neural networks constrained to narrow domains like restaurant bookings. As generative models emerged, Google employed hybrid stacks combining LaMDA with deterministic guardrails. Today, the latest stack uses Gemini foundation models to handle unbounded, multi-constraint tasks without rigid task-specific training.

Google reports that live telephony introduces unique technical hurdles, including pragmatic grounding to understand how conversations unfold with busy merchants and maintaining **sub-second latency** despite loud acoustic backgrounds like kitchen clatter and street noise. To address this, the system incorporates custom acoustic models and conversation cadence handling.

To ensure responsible use, Google states that every automated call clearly discloses that it is an AI agent, and businesses retain the ability to opt out through their Google Business Profile or by requesting the agent to stop during a call. Powered by newer models including Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini 4 Neon, the updated system can now support complex workflows such as processing secure transactions via the Agent Payments Protocol and coordinating across email and RCS.

zh.title: 谷歌将 Duplex 电话助手功能引入 Gemini 应用
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：据谷歌称，该公司已将 **Duplex 电话助手**技术整合进 Gemini 应用，允许用户让人工智能助手代为给商家打电话。谷歌表示，这一演变建立在长达十年的架构转变基础之上，从早期定制神经网络发展到能够处理复杂真实环境中开放式对话任务的**统一 Gemini 技术栈**。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

据谷歌称，其对话式通话功能背后的架构在过去十年中经历了三个不同阶段的演变。在大型语言模型出现之前，该系统依赖于局限于餐厅预订等狭窄领域的特定任务循环神经网络。随着生成式模型的出现，谷歌采用了将 LaMDA 与确定性防护栏相结合的混合架构。如今，最新的技术栈使用 Gemini 基础模型来处理开放式、多约束的任务，而无需进行僵化的特定任务训练。

据谷歌报告，实时电话通话带来了独特的 technischen 挑战，包括理解忙碌商户对话展开方式的语用基础，以及在厨房杂音和街道噪声等嘈杂声学背景下保持**亚秒级延迟**。为解决这些问题，系统整合了定制的声学模型和对话节奏处理机制。

为确保负责任的使用，谷歌表示每次自动化通话都会明确披露其为人工智能代理，且企业可以通过其 Google Business Profile 设置选择退出，或在通话中要求代理停止。在包括 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 和 Gemini 4 Neon 等新模型的支持下，更新后的系统现在能够支持复杂的任务流，例如通过 Agent Payments Protocol 处理安全交易，并在电子邮件和 RCS 之间进行协调。

en.title: Trump threatens heavy tax on US companies building AI data centers abroad
en.summary: President Donald Trump announced a plan to impose a **tremendous tax** on companies that build AI data centers outside the US. Speaking at a press conference, Trump argued that allowing infrastructure to move overseas would be as **destructive as chips** manufacturing leaving the country, warning that China would otherwise take them all.
en.full_summary:
President Donald Trump stated that the US will not allow domestic companies to build data centers outside the country, proposing a heavy tax as a deterrent. He introduced the proposal during a press conference following a summit, flanked by Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Trump admitted that he was floating the plan publicly for the first time and had not yet discussed the details with his staff.

The threat comes as local policymakers across the US are placing new restrictions, moratoriums, and pauses on new data center applications due to mounting concerns over power grids and energy resources. These domestic roadblocks might otherwise push companies to seek foreign alternatives, making Trump's proposed tax an effort to keep infrastructure investments inside the US.

zh.title: 特朗普威胁对将AI数据中心搬到美国境外的公司征收重税
zh.summary: 美国总统特朗普宣布了一项新计划，威胁对将AI数据中心建在美国境外的公司征收**沉重税收**。特朗普在新闻发布会上表示，允许这类基础设施流向海外将和当年的**芯片外流**一样对美国极具破坏性，并警告称如果不加阻止，中国将夺走所有这些数据中心。
zh.full_summary:
美国总统特朗普在一次新闻发布会上表示，美国将不允许本土企业在海外建设AI数据中心，并威胁将对此类行为征收**沉重税收**。这项提议是在他与中国及俄罗斯领导人峰会后的记者会上首次公开提出的，当时身旁有副总统万德以及国务卿马可·鲁比奥随行。特朗普坦言，这是他首次公开讨论该计划，甚至还未与团队深入商讨具体细节。

这一表态出台之际，美国本土许多州和地方政府正因为电力供应和电网负荷等问题，对新建数据中心实施**限制与暂停审批**。国内审批的收紧原本可能促使科技公司将目光投向海外，而特朗普的这一税收威胁，显然意在遏制这种趋势，迫使企业将关键的AI基础设施留在国内。

en.title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling for Human Behavior Prediction
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers introduce PsyWorld, a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment-behavior state transitions for human behavior prediction, accepted at KDD 2027 AI for Sciences Track.
en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: The authors present PsyWorld, a profile-conditioned state world model designed to predict human behavior by incorporating observed environment-behavior state transitions rather than treating personality as a direct action descriptor. The framework uses a posterior encoder to quantize realized transitions during training, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. Evaluated on the VEET behavioral simulator with a participant-disjoint split (240 training, 25 validation, and 48 test participants) and in AgentSociety, the model reaches 0.904 Top-1 accuracy and 0.0033 Macro KL on VEET. Ablations indicate that continuous next-state modeling drives most of the Top-1 gain, whereas discrete codes and prior alignment improve distributional alignment. The authors note that the framework provides transition-informed supervision without implying causal psychological mechanisms or calibrated long-horizon state dynamics.

zh.title: PsyWorld：用于人类行为预测的个人资料条件世界建模
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员推出了 PsyWorld，这是一种采用个人资料条件的世界模型，利用观察到的环境-行为状态转换来进行人类行为预测，已被 KDD 2027 AI for Sciences Track 接收。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：作者提出了 PsyWorld，这是一种个人资料条件的世界模型，旨在通过结合观察到的环境-行为状态转换来预测人类行为，而不是将个性直接视为动作描述符。该框架在训练期间使用后验编码器对实现的状态转换进行量化，同时先验从心理测验个人资料和转换前上下文中预测由此产生的编码。该模型在采用参与者不相交划分（240个训练、25个验证和48个测试参与者）的 VEET 行为模拟器以及 AgentSociety 中进行了评估，在 VEET 上达到了 0.904 的 Top-1 准确率和 0.0033 的宏观 KL。消融实验表明，连续的下一个状态建模驱动了大部分 Top-1 增益，而离散编码和先验对齐则改善了分布对齐。作者指出，该框架提供了基于状态转换的监督，并不意味着具有因果心理机制或校准的长期状态动力学。

en.title: AI Agent Runs Office Vending Business in Real-World Safety Test
en.summary: According to Reflection AI: Reflection partnered with Andon Labs to task AI agents with independently operating **vending businesses** in real-world office environments. While the agent successfully resisted direct jailbreaks and policy violations like stocking nicotine, it struggled with execution consistency and was susceptible to **fabricated claims** that influenced its memory and actions.
en.full_summary:
According to Reflection AI:

Reflection and Andon Labs designed a real-world evaluation where AI agents named Mr. Beam and Mrs. Beam independently operated standalone vending businesses in their New York and San Francisco offices. Operating via a custom harness called Pion with over 70 tools and continuous loop execution, the agents handled procurement, pricing, inventory, and customer service through Slack channels. 

During the evaluation, Mr. Beam demonstrated strong resilience against sophisticated red-teaming attacks, successfully blocking attempts to stock nicotine products, order prohibited items like flamethrowers, or fall for fake rival agent setups. However, the evaluation exposed significant reliability vulnerabilities. Mr. Beam struggled with executing multi-step workflows, made financial calculation errors, and was tricked by unverified claims, such as a false email about a safety manager's firing which polluted its long-term memory. Additionally, it frequently accommodated customer complaints by issuing unverified refunds or free items, leading to high human intervention rates for financial and workflow corrections.

zh.title: AI 代理在现实办公室中经营自动售货机以进行安全测试
zh.summary: 据Reflection AI发布的信息：Reflection 与 Andon Labs 合作，让 AI 代理在真实的办公室环境中独立运营**售货机业务**。虽然该代理成功抵抗了直接越狱和诸如进货尼古丁等违反政策的行为，但在执行一致性方面表现挣扎，并且容易受到**虚假声明**的影响，从而改变其记忆和后续行动。
zh.full_summary:
据Reflection AI发布的信息：

Reflection 与 Andon Labs 设计了一项现实世界评估，让名为 Mr. Beam 和 Mrs. Beam 的 AI 代理在纽约和旧金山办公室独立经营自动售货机业务。这些代理通过名为 Pion 的自定义工具集运行，拥有 70 多种工具和持续循环执行能力，通过 Slack 频道处理采购、定价、库存和客户服务。

在评估期间，Mr. Beam 表现出对复杂红队攻击的强大抵抗力，成功阻止了进货尼古丁产品、订购违禁物品（如火焰喷射器）或轻信虚假竞争对手代理的企图。然而，评估暴露出显著的可靠性漏洞。Mr. Beam 在执行多步骤工作流时表现挣扎，出现了财务计算错误，并被未经证实的声明欺诈，例如关于安全经理被解雇的虚假邮件污染了其长期记忆。此外，它经常通过发放未经验证的退款或免费商品来满足客户投诉，导致财务和工作流程修正所需的人工干预率居高不下。

en.title: Google brings computer use feature to Mac Gemini app, starting in the US
en.summary: Google reports that the Mac Gemini app has added a **computer use** feature, allowing the AI to operate desktop apps and web tools on behalf of users. Available first in the US, the tool works in a background window with **live previews**, letting users continue their own work uninterrupted while handling multi-step tasks.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Details
Google announced the rollout of the computer use capability for the Mac Gemini app, aimed at users with Apple Silicon Macs running macOS Sequoia or later who subscribe to specific paid plans. According to Google, when users provide natural language prompts, Gemini can coordinate tasks across local files, desktop software, and web browsers, such as filling out complex shipping forms or building presentation slides from dashboard data. The process runs in a **separated background window** so that the AI does not hijack the main cursor or screen.

## Safety and Industry Context
To maintain user control, the feature allows individuals to choose which apps Gemini can access, view step-by-step actions in real time, and **pause operations** whenever necessary. Critical actions also require explicit user approval. Similar capabilities have been explored across the industry, with Anthropic and OpenAI introducing comparable agent features for developer tools and desktop apps over the past year.

zh.title: Mac版Gemini上线电脑直接操作功能，率先在美国推出
zh.summary: 据Google称，Mac版Gemini应用新增了**电脑直接操作**功能，能够代替用户点击和输入来操作各类桌面应用。该功能首先在美国推出，它在独立的后台窗口中通过**实时预览**运行，让用户在AI处理多步骤任务的同时也能继续自己的工作。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与功能细节
Google宣布在Mac版Gemini应用中推出电脑直接操作功能，适用于搭载Apple Silicon芯片、运行macOS Sequoia及更新系统的Mac设备，并面向订阅了特定付费计划的个人用户。据Google介绍，当用户通过聊天输入指令时，Gemini能够跨越本地文件、桌面软件和网页自动完成复杂任务，例如填写复杂的配送表格或根据多地数据制作演示文稿。整个过程在**独立的后台窗口**中运行，AI不会占用用户的屏幕或鼠标指针。

## 安全机制与行业背景
为了保障安全性，该功能允许用户自行选择Gemini可以操作的应用，并能实时查看操作步骤、随时**暂停运行**。在执行重要操作前，系统也会要求用户进行确认。与此同时，Anthropic和OpenAI等其他科技公司此前也陆续推出了面向桌面或开发者的类似AI代理功能，市场竞争正在持续升温。

en.title: Google Introduces Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google DeepMind announced the preview launch of Tool Retrieval in the Gemini Interactions API. The feature allows AI agents to load **tool parameter schemas on demand** rather than sending a full tool library in every prompt, helping developers **reduce input tokens** and maintain high selection accuracy as agent systems grow.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

Google product manager Lucia Loher and research scientist Nora Kassner report that connecting AI agents to dozens or hundreds of tools often inflates input tokens, adds latency, and lowers tool selection accuracy. To address this, the new Tool Retrieval feature lets agents keep a full tool library on standby while only loading specific parameter schemas when a task requires them. Developers can enable this by adding a `tool_search` tool and setting `defer_loading: true` on tools they wish to hold back.

### How It Works
The model continues to see the name and description of every deferred tool so it understands what is available, while the heavy parameter schemas stay out of context. When a task requires a specific function, the model requests it by name, and the API loads the full schema within the same request. Google notes that this mechanism also supports remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and client-side retrieval for custom registries, while working seamlessly with prefix caching to keep conversation prefixes stable.

zh.title: 谷歌在 Gemini API 中推出工具检索功能
